summary: Kerb with several cars parked, homes 12-17 m away on this side, bush opposite.
reasons: Homes 12-17 m away on own side
Cars already park along this kerb

best_section.where: Past the cars parked near 100 m, before the junction at the east end

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses line the north kerb at 12-17 m; bush reserve opposite so no neighbours across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where several vehicles stand; room to park at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet suburban road with overhead lines; occasional local traffic.
drivers.convention: Parked cars and a utility-style van along the kerb, so a van won't stand out.

flags: Mean grade 3.7%, about 2-3% at best section
Sandy Creek 113 m away, min elevation 11 m
sun_shade: Mostly open; houses cast shade from the north in the morning, bush to the south.
